messages:
mia: Heads-up — saw a spike of customer tickets after the last launch for the new routing layer. A few are legit regressions, some are feature asks. Need a quick decision on bug vs enhancement and shipping plan.

sam: Can you list the top customer-reported items? Which are blocking usage?

mia: Quick list: 1) streaming sessions dropping intermittently (5 customers), 2) interface glitch in the console quota view (nonblocking), 3) unexpected tokenization difference in embeddings for one dataset (1 customer, impacts accuracy).

priyanka: Streaming drops sound like a regression we should treat as P1 (affects availability). Tokenization accuracy is annoying but might be a P2 unless it's affecting legal/regulatory customers. Console UI glitch -> P3.

jordan: Agree with Pri. Do we have repro for streaming? Any recent infra churn?

sam: Devs already identified a correlation with the new batching fallback rule introduced in the runtime patch. Repro is flaky locally but consistent in prod logs.

ash: If it's the fallback rule, we can rollback the micro-change as a hotfix and run a small canary. Rollback should be low risk. I can own it.

mia: Timeline: customer-facing fix in next 48 hours preferred. We also need a follow-up plan to avoid repeated regressions — e.g., mandatory canaries + scoped telemetry for batching decisions.

priyanka: For prioritization doc: propose we allocate next sprint 40% to immediate stability (hotfix + monitoring), 30% to critical customer regressions (tokenization accuracy investigation), 20% to backlog enhancements, 10% to polish (console). Thoughts?

jordan: That split seems reasonable given current SLA signals. We should lock the hotfix window: patch -> canary -> full rollout within 24h if canary looks good.

sam: Ops note: we have one Dedicated customer with a higher SLA who is impacted. Recommend we fast-track the hotfix for them and offer a mitigated SLA credit communication.

mia: Approved. Ash to run rollback microdeploy and validate canary. Sam to coordinate notice with CS for the dedicated customer. Pri to start tokenization triage doc and add acceptance criteria. Jordan to schedule a 30-min postmortem after rollout.

ash: On it. I’ll post logs and canary link when ready.

deploy-bot: deploy started by ash at 1768423600 — rollback microdeploy to runtime v2.14.1 -> canary cluster.

priyanka: Acceptance criteria for tokenization triage: 1) deterministic reproduce on a staging dataset, 2) regression test added to embedding-eval harness, 3) patch plan with rollback.

sam: CS note drafted and ready to send once we confirm canary health.

mia: Thanks team. If canary fails, we shift the sprint split to 60% stability, 25% regressions, 15% enhancements and pause noncritical rollouts. Will re-open if anything changes. :thumbsup:

ash: Canary healthy so far — posting metrics: latency stable, error rate down to baseline. Will promote after 30m of quiet.

deploy-bot: canary health check passed at 1768423730.

mia: Great. Sam — please trigger CS message and set customer expectations. Pri — please handoff tokenization doc by EOD. Jordan — schedule postmortem tomorrow 10am.

sam: Message sent to affected accounts; offered expedited patch notes and a follow-up call.

priyanka: Docs uploaded: tokenization-triage.md, test vectors attached.

jordan: Postmortem calendar invite sent.

mia: Closing this thread — follow the action items in the ticket. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
